g.text: What the client is waiting for

svg.metadata:
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown # DHCP client finite-state machine (RFC 2131 §4.4, simplified). # Genre: statechart — EXPERIMENTAL, and it needs `figdown 0.2` (`STATECHART-GENRE-SCOPE`). The two # companion TABLE sections below stay `figdown 0.1`: the version a section # declares is the surface that section needs, and a table needs nothing from # 0.2. Sections are separate documents (`MULTI-FIGURE-DOCUMENTS`), so the versions may differ. # # MULTI-LINE guide/authoring.md DEMO: # 1) node labels: "NAME\nshort role" → wraps on canvas # 2) edge mids: -["why\nwhat"]-> → reason always on the drawing # 3) # blocks: multi-line prose → edit like Markdown (not in SVG) # 4) table cells: text
more → multi-line list form # # Why some paths used to look "unlabeled": SVG only shows mid labels, not # # comments. Every edge mid is now two lines: reason + action/outcome. figdown 0.2 statechart title "DHCP client statechart (RFC 2131)\nmulti-line authoring sample" class mode "DHCP client protocol state" fill=#e0e7ff # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ # STATES — multi-line canvas label + multi-line # narrative # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ state init "INIT\nno lease" class=mode # No usable IPv4 lease on the interface. # Next step is usually broadcast DISCOVER, unless a stored lease # steers the client into INIT-REBOOT instead. state selecting "SELECTING\ncollect OFFERs" class=mode # One or more DHCPOFFER frames have arrived. # Client has not yet committed to a server / address. state requesting "REQUESTING\nawait ACK/NAK" class=mode # DHCPREQUEST outstanding (selecting an OFFER, or confirming # a remembered address on the reboot path). state bound "BOUND\nlease active" class=mode # Address in use (yiaddr / assigned). # T1 and T2 timers run; data plane may use the lease. # "Data plane" there is the NETWORKING term — the forwarding path — and not # FigDown's `plane`, which was WITHDRAWN from the language # (`PAINT-ORDER-CONSTRUCT`). That a comment in a DHCP figure reaches for the word in its domain # sense, unprompted, is the collision that withdrew the keyword. state renewing "RENEWING\nT1 unicast" class=mode # T1 fired. Client unicasts DHCPREQUEST to the server # that granted the current lease. state rebinding "REBINDING\nT2 broadcast" class=mode # T2 fired (or renew path gave up). Client broadcasts # DHCPREQUEST so any server may extend the lease. state init_reboot "INIT-REBOOT\nstored lease" class=mode # Power-on (or restart) with a previously allocated address # still believed valid; confirm before using it. state rebooting "REBOOTING\nconfirm lease" class=mode # Confirmation REQUEST in flight for the remembered address. # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ # TRANSITIONS — every mid is reason + outcome (visible on SVG) # # comments hold longer prose for .fd editors (not drawn) # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ # --- acquire --- transition init -["need address\nsnd DISCOVER"]-> selecting # trigger: begin acquire (no stored lease, or policy chooses discover) # effect: broadcast DHCPDISCOVER; start collecting DHCPOFFER transition selecting -["offer chosen\nsnd REQUEST"]-> requesting # trigger: client picks one OFFER # effect: broadcast DHCPREQUEST with server-id + requested-ip transition requesting -["server grants\nACK → use IP"]-> bound # trigger: DHCPACK # effect: install address; arm T1/T2; interface up for that lease transition requesting -["REQUEST failed\nNAK/timeout → INIT"]-> init # trigger: DHCPNAK, or retries exhausted # effect: discard candidate; return to INIT # note: individual REQUEST retransmits are collapsed (not drawn) # --- renew / rebind --- transition bound -["T1: renew time\nunicast REQUEST"]-> renewing # trigger: T1 (renewal time) # effect: unicast DHCPREQUEST to binding server transition renewing -["lease extended\nACK → BOUND"]-> bound # trigger: DHCPACK from binding server # effect: refresh lease timers; stay configured transition renewing -["server refuses\nNAK → drop IP"]-> init # trigger: DHCPNAK # effect: stop using address; rediscover transition renewing -["T2: rebind time\nbcast REQUEST"]-> rebinding # trigger: T2 (rebinding time) while still unacked # effect: broaden REQUEST to broadcast transition rebinding -["any server OK\nACK → BOUND"]-> bound # trigger: DHCPACK from any willing server # effect: new binding parameters; back to BOUND transition rebinding -["no lease left\nNAK / expiry"]-> init # trigger: DHCPNAK, or lease lifetime ends # effect: must not use address; INIT # --- reboot path --- transition init -["remembered lease\n→ confirm path"]-> init_reboot # trigger: non-volatile lease remembered across restart # else: remain INIT and take DISCOVER path transition init_reboot -["confirm stored lease\nsnd REQUEST (bcast)"]-> rebooting # trigger: start confirmation of remembered address # effect: broadcast DHCPREQUEST for that address # (this is the INIT-REBOOT → REBOOTING arc — pinned on its own row below) transition rebooting -["lease confirmed\nACK → BOUND"]-> bound # trigger: server confirms stored address # effect: configure interface; arm timers (same as acquire ACK) transition rebooting -["cannot confirm\nNAK/timeout → INIT"]-> init # trigger: refusal or no answer # effect: forget stored lease; full rediscover # --- release / loss --- transition bound -["give up / lost lease\nRELEASE → INIT"]-> init # trigger: DHCPRELEASE, or lease lost without renew # effect: optional DHCPRELEASE; clear configuration # Hand layout: three bands — the cold-acquire row, the reboot row beneath # it, and the renew/rebind column under BOUND. Presentation only (`GUI-WRITEBACK-STRUCTURE`): # delete every `pin` below and all eight states and all fifteen labelled # transitions are still here, in the `node`/`edge` lines above. # # RE-AUTHORED (`EDGE-GEOMETRY-CONSTRUCTS`), AND THIS FIGURE IS WHY THE MEASUREMENT # MATTERED. It used to open the zone with `routing orthogonal` and carry # five hand-routed lines that ran short return corridors just under # the acquire row. All six constructs were WITHDRAWN from the language — # see spec/migrations.md 0.1 and core §9 `EDGE-IDENTITY-AND-GEOMETRY` — and the geometry # they encoded had SHIPPED A DEFECT: the corridors reached x=20 and the # canvas only ever grew right and down, so the published artifact drew # "membered lease" for "remembered lease" and "nnot confirm" for "cannot # confirm". Author waypoints did not protect this figure; they clipped it. # # The grid below is the same three bands, opened out. The old one was # built for corridors — 140 px between centres, boxes 96-112 px wide — # so with the corridors gone the transition labels printed straight over # the node boxes. Centres are now ~220 px apart and the reboot row sits # 220 px down, which is the whole fix: no clipping, no label over a box. # On tools/layout-lint.js the figure went 23 -> 8 (the tightest possible # strip scores 6, but it is the one that overprints labels, which the # linter does not measure — the number was checked against the picture, # not instead of it). flow right layout # row 0 — cold acquire, left to right pin init at=(20,40) width=96 height=44 pin selecting at=(230,40) width=112 height=44 pin requesting at=(450,40) width=112 height=44 pin bound at=(670,40) width=100 height=44 # row 1 left — reboot path under INIT/SELECTING pin init_reboot at=(20,260) width=112 height=44 pin rebooting at=(230,260) width=112 height=44 # column under BOUND — renew then rebind pin renewing at=(670,160) width=100 height=44 pin rebinding at=(666,280) width=108 height=44 # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ # COMPANION TABLES — multi-line cells via
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ figdown 0.1 table table states "State catalog (multi-line notes in cells)" | State | Role on wire | What the client is waiting for | |-------------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------------| | INIT | no lease | policy to DISCOVER
or INIT-REBOOT | | SELECTING | OFFERs arriving | choose server / address | | REQUESTING | REQUEST outstanding | ACK or NAK | | BOUND | address configured
T1/T2 running | T1, RELEASE, or link loss | | RENEWING | unicast renew | ACK, NAK, or T2 | | REBINDING | broadcast renew | ACK, NAK, or lease end | | INIT-REBOOT | remembered lease | send confirm REQUEST | | REBOOTING | confirm REQUEST out | ACK or NAK/timeout | figdown 0.1 table table tr "Transition list (why → what)" | From → To | Why (reason) | What happens | |------------------------|---------------------------------|-----------------------------------------| | INIT → SELECTING | need an address | snd DHCPDISCOVER (bcast) | | SELECTING → REQUESTING | an OFFER was chosen | snd DHCPREQUEST (bcast) | | REQUESTING → BOUND | server grants lease | configure if;
arm T1/T2 | | REQUESTING → INIT | refused or timed out | discard candidate;
restart | | BOUND → RENEWING | T1 renewal time | unicast REQUEST | | RENEWING → BOUND | lease extended | reset timers | | RENEWING → INIT | server refuses | drop address | | RENEWING → REBINDING | T2; binding server silent | broadcast REQUEST | | REBINDING → BOUND | some server extends | accept new binding | | REBINDING → INIT | no lease left | stop using address | | INIT → INIT-REBOOT | remembered lease at boot | skip cold DISCOVER | | INIT-REBOOT → REBOOTING| must confirm old IP | bcast REQUEST for old addr | | REBOOTING → BOUND | lease confirmed | same as acquire ACK | | REBOOTING → INIT | cannot confirm | full rediscover | | BOUND → INIT | release or lease lost | optional DHCPRELEASE;
clear config |
